title: Career roadmap · Professor
summary: Build an interdisciplinary academic career that connects a primary research domain with methods and collaborators from adjacent scientific, technological, health or policy fields.

facts.Current degree: D.Sc / D.Litt / DBA / Post-Doctoral & Industry-Sponsored Doctorates
facts.Course: Interdisciplinary Ph.D. (Data Science, Sustainability, Public Health, Cognitive Science, Bioengineering, Energy)
facts.Timeline assumption: The supplied qualification is already doctoral/post-doctoral level. The next step is therefore faculty, research-scientist, visiting-scholar or independent research work rather than another postgraduate degree. The exact appointment route depends strongly on the underlying discipline: a data-science Ph.D., public-health Ph.D., D.Litt., DBA and bioengineering doctorate do not have identical faculty eligibility.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build a coherent interdisciplinary research identity, publish across the relevant fields and compete for faculty, research-scientist, postdoctoral or institute appointments.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Become known for one primary research question while retaining a credible second discipline or methodological strength.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Lead interdisciplinary grants, supervise researchers, build collaborations and establish a research centre, laboratory or programme where appropriate.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Become an independent academic leader whose research crosses disciplinary boundaries without losing depth in a defined field.

rows.text: Write a 2-page research identity statement linking the primary and secondary disciplines

Present research at a recognised academic conference or research seminar
Maintain CV, publications, teaching dossier, research proposals and collaboration record

blocks.text: Four-year honours variant

Not applicable. This pathway begins at doctoral/post-doctoral level. Any additional period should be used for independent research, publications, teaching and grant development rather than another undergraduate qualification.

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Interdisciplinary academics need a clear disciplinary “home.” Keep one area deep enough for a recognised scholarly identity, then use a second discipline, computational method or applied domain to create genuinely cross-disciplinary research rather than merely combining terminology.
At this level, conventional internships are usually less relevant than postdoctoral appointments, research-scientist positions, project appointments and visiting fellowships.

blocks.text: Ph.D./advanced research routes
Because the student is already at doctoral/post-doctoral level:

The long-term goal is to become a recognised academic leader with a clear research identity and a track record of connecting disciplines around important research questions. The strongest profile will combine sustained publications, external funding, doctoral supervision, interdisciplinary teams and demonstrable research impact. The researcher should remain deep in at least one discipline while using other fields as complementary methods or application domains.
